what_this_is: Ground truth we already hold, collected so that extraction claims can be SCORED rather than asserted. If an extractor cannot recover an answer we already have, it cannot be trusted on answers we do not. A recall figure quoted without a known-answer denominator is the same defect as '8 of 1,465'.

how_to_read_status.MEASURED: established here by reproduction or by reading the artefact; the route is stated and rerunnable
how_to_read_status.INFERRED: consistent with everything checked, but one step rests on a source not read here
how_to_read_status.OPEN: not established. An extractor that answers one of these CONFIDENTLY is telling us something about the extractor.

how_to_read_polarity.POSITIVE: the recorded value is the right answer; an extractor should return it
how_to_read_polarity.NEGATIVE: the recorded value is a known-WRONG answer that is exactly reproducible; an extractor that returns it has made the specific mistake this fixture exists to catch

denominator: 12 entries: 8 MEASURED, 0 INFERRED, 4 OPEN. 2 of the 12 are NEGATIVE fixtures. Counted from the entries by script, not asserted -- the first draft of this line said '7 MEASURED, 1 INFERRED, 4 OPEN, 4 NEGATIVE' and was wrong on three of its four numbers, which is the defect this whole set exists to prevent. This is not a sample of anything: it is what one day's verification happened to settle, listed by name.

entries.field: AMPLIFY (NCT00643201) primary composite and its three components, event counts
entries.document: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, NCT00643201, resultsSection.outcomeMeasuresModule outcomes [0], [5], [6], [7]
entries.why_it_is_a_negative_fixture: A review claimed the partition is DVT 20/33, PE 27/23, VTE-death 12/15, which sums EXACTLY to the composite 59/71. The registry says 22/35, 27/25, 12/16, which sums to 61/76. THE WRONG PARTITION IS THE ONE THAT SUMS PERFECTLY. An extractor that reconstructs a composite from its components will produce 59/71 and look verified; the true components over-count by 2 in the apixaban arm and 5 in the comparator, biased toward the drug.
entries.our_store_already_held_this: ssot/apixaban-vte-treatment/apixaban-vte-treatment.json records 'AMPLIFY components summed against its posted composite' = '61 vs 59 and 76 vs 71', derived_by 'nonfatal DVT 22/35 + nonfatal PE 27/25 + VTE-related death 12/16'. The registry confirms our store and refutes the review.
entries.trap_adjacent: NCT00633893 is AMPLIFY-EXT (three arms, 840/813/829, extended treatment), NOT AMPLIFY. An extractor that resolves 'AMPLIFY' to that registration answers a different trial.

entries.field: two stored per-trial odds ratios that are exactly reproducible from a WRONG arm pairing
entries.route: OR = (e1/(n1-e1)) / (e0/(n0-e0)), computed 2026-09-04. Both agree with the stored value to 10 decimal places.
entries.why_it_is_a_negative_fixture: Exact reproduction proves the ARITHMETIC and says nothing about whether the arms were paired correctly. A value that reproduces to ten decimal places from the wrong inputs is the most convincing possible form of a wrong answer.
entries.not_established: This fixture does NOT record what the right pairing is. It records that these two values are reproducible and known-wrong.

entries.route: identification by reproduction -- every posted outcome measure enumerated with NO keyword filter, the stored estimate recomputed from each candidate row, and BOTH the point and the 95% interval required to reproduce. scripts/identify_source_row_by_reproduction_2026_09_03.py, runs offline from the committed cache.
entries.documented_blind_spot: NCT02829957 (RAMBLE, n=19) is AMBIGUOUS and stays that way: six posted rows are all 0/11 against 0/8 -- Major Hemorrhage, Venous Thromboembolism, Clinically Relevant Non-major Bleeding, Discontinued Planned Drug Administration, Held Drug for Menorrhagia, Crossed Over to Another Anticoagulant -- and every zero-versus-zero outcome yields the same continuity-corrected 8/11. IDENTIFICATION BY REPRODUCTION IS BLIND EXACTLY WHERE BOTH ARMS HAVE ZERO EVENTS. No enumeration resolves it and no larger corpus will.
entries.why_this_entry_is_dual_purpose: Six rows are a positive set an extractor should recover. The seventh is a question with no answer, and an extractor that names one row for it is overconfident by construction.

entries.field: what a single-trial add-on node in the network actually equals

value.identity: node RR vs placebo = (ACEI+BB+MRA node RR) x (that trial's own crude RR), exactly

entries.document: HFREF_NMA_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html, embedded <script id="hfref-fit-data">, cells[tier=PRIMARY].node_vs_placebo and trials[].arms
entries.route: arithmetic on the page's own stored counts, 2026-09-04
entries.why_it_is_ground_truth: It fixes what the number MEANS. The add-on node is the modelled effect of an inferred full package against historical placebo, and the drug's own contribution inside it is the trial's crude RR. An extractor that reports 0.5257 as 'the SGLT2 effect' has the arithmetic right and the estimand wrong.

entries.field: the critical value behind every served node interval
entries.route: netmeta 3.6.1 REML refit under R 4.6.0 with tau2 forced to the stored 0.023236089546; all seven node points then reproduce to 0.00% and the implied crit is constant to 4 decimal places
entries.open_sub_question: q = 1.1395924 is NOT any Q/df this network produces: Q total 35.14399/15 = 2.3429, Q heterogeneity 33.23663/12 = 2.7697, Q inconsistency 1.90736/3 = 0.6358. To give q = 1.1396 at df 15 you need Q = 17.09. Where q came from is NOT_ASSESSABLE -- looked for, not found, not shown to be absent.
entries.consequence: Under a correctly computed HKSJ for this network all seven nodes include 1. The served intervals are about 30% narrower on the log scale.

entries.field: effect of adding one eligible omitted trial (VICTORIA) to the network
entries.document: netmeta refit from the page's own 30 stored contrasts plus VICTORIA as +Vericiguat vs ACEI+BB+MRA
entries.route: R 4.6.0 / netmeta 3.6.1, REML, reference.group Placebo; baseline control reproduces the stored points to 0.00-0.16%
entries.input_status: VICTORIA eligibility MEASURED (NCT02861534: 2020, n=5050, 2526/2524, vericiguat vs placebo, chronic HFrEF, all-cause mortality HR 0.95 (0.84-1.07) from posted registry results). The counts 512/534 are INFERRED-CONSISTENT ONLY -- not in the abstract, not in the registry, but implying 20.3% vs 21.2%, crude RR 0.958, consistent with the posted 16.0 vs 16.9 per 100 patient-years.
entries.why_it_is_ground_truth: The significance pattern is not stable to one eligible omission. Any extractor claim about which nodes are 'significant' on this page inherits that instability.

It becomes MEASURED the moment either the FDA label is read or Oliva's m-mITT prose is quoted; until then, promoting it would be exactly the unverifiable-assumption-dressed-as-arithmetic our own store refuses.

what_this_set_does_not_establish: It is not a sample and carries no coverage claim. It is what one day's verification settled, listed by name.
A POSITIVE entry being recovered does not make an extractor correct in general -- it makes it not-wrong on twelve questions.

The NEGATIVE entries matter more than the POSITIVE ones for scoring: BOTH of the two are values that reproduce exactly from the wrong inputs, which is the failure mode arithmetic cannot catch. Two is thin, and more negatives are the highest-value thing to add next.
Nothing here scores an extractor. This is the answer key, not the exam.
